ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

visibleTextNormalized: Fort Street Foundation Tertiary Bursary Application The Ashford Sister's Tertiary Bursaries seek to support motivated individuals with demonstrated merit, who are facing financial hardship. The bursaries provide financial assistance to Fortians completing Year 12 who intend to continue studying either at University, Private Institution or TAFE after finishing their HSC. The bursaries assist with the transition into and progress through post-school education e.g. University bachelor degrees, Private Institution bachelor degree, TAFE accredited apprenticeship or a TAFE Advanced Diploma. About the Bursary Each bursary offered consists of an annual payment of up to $3,000 provided at the commencement of each academic year, up to a maximum of 3 years. For students relocating from Sydney, an additional one-off payment of up to $2,000 may be provided to assist with initial relocation expenses. The value of the bursary offered to successful students will be based on their personal circumstances and choice of post-school education. How to Apply Please download and carefully read through the Application Information and Terms and Conditions. Teacher Supporting Statement Request a supporting statement from a FSHS teacher (teacher may complete directly online or download Teacher Supporting Statement here (opens in new window) ) 3. Independent Support statement Complete your independent supporting statement here. 4. Parent/Guardian Consent Complete a parent guardian consent form here.
